svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The team builder: even teams from tonight's players (organiser, crew)
svg.text: 09 · The team builder: even teams from tonight's players (organiser, crew)
Use case: 18 players want to play but nobody has a team; the crew picks them, the builder balances six teams by ranking, the crew swaps two and starts

g.text: Pick the players; the builder makes teams of three with rankings as even as it can.
Drag a player onto another to swap them; the sums and the spread update at once.

svg.text: The builder is the core's: random draws, the most even sums kept; 'Draw again' re-rolls. Sizes follow the formats (9 to 36 players).
Rankings are 0–100 and move after each season; the crew adjusts one with a slider, never a typed number (D4).
